## Required visual-evidence refresh — complete for every PR

- [ ] **Screenshots:** Ran `npm run screenshots`; reviewed the complete set of 14 current browser captures.
- [ ] **Guidebook:** Regenerated and reviewed all six GIFs and all six posters from those browser captures.
- [ ] **Docs:** Updated README.md and relevant docs; refreshed `docs/VERIFICATION.md` and `docs/visual-evidence.json`.
- [ ] **Integrity:** `npm run visual-evidence:check` passes against the committed images and GIFs.

Do not leave a box unchecked. Run the full capture even when the change appears unrelated to the UI; if an image is byte-identical, the refreshed manifest and capture record still belong in this PR.
